{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the data types of the columns
sales_df.dtypes

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df[~sales_df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float)))]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Check if there are any NaN values in the revenue column
nan_revenue_count = completed_orders['revenue'].isnull().sum()

sales_df.dtypes, non_numeric_revenue, mean_revenue_completed, nan_revenue_count"}
